REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the May 26, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-06-16 Item 08A Minutes
2021-06-16 Item 08A Public Comments Received Before 3PM
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Sanderson
Approve the Warrants.
2021-06-16 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Grant application for the Rebuilding American Infrastructure with Sustainability and Equity (RAISE) Grant Program for Leucadia Streetscape. Contact Person: Acting City Engineer Bankston
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to apply for, accept and administer funding from the Rebuilding American Infrastructure with Sustainability and Equity (RAISE) Grant Program for Leucadia Streetscape.
2021-06-16 Item 08C Streetscape RAISE Grant Application
8D.
Authorization for the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2021-33 authorizing the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records in accordance with the City’s Records Retention Schedule and the Government Code.
2021-06-16 Item 08D Destruction of Records
8E.
Request to waive city fees for the Silver Age Yoga Program held at the Encinitas Library Community Room and Cardiff Sports Park. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor II Garrison
1) Approve waiving room rental and staffing fees for Silver Age Yoga to offer a one-hour senior yoga class at the Encinitas Library Community Room one day a week for a period of one year beginning on July 1, 2021 and ending June 30, 2022; and 2) Approve waiving commercial use permit fees for Silver Age Yoga, for calendar years 2021, and 2022, to offer a one-hour senior yoga class at the Cardiff Sports Park Expansion area two days a week.
2021-06-16 Item 08E Silver Age Yoga - Waiving of Fees
8F.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and San Diego County Bicycle Coalition to provide City Cycling courses at the Encinitas Community Center. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Karlen
Approve and authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) in substantial form, as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, between the City of Encinitas and San Diego County Bicycle Coalition to provide City Cycling courses at the Encinitas Community Center.
2021-06-16 Item 08F MOU San Diego Bike Coalition
8G.
Enhancement of Native Habitats in the San Elijo Lagoon Ecological Reserve (WB16B). Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Adopt Resolution No. 2021-63 Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-06-16 Item 08G WB16B Enhancement of Native Habitats
8H.
Commission for the Arts Work Plan Outcomes for FY 2020-21 and Proposed Work Plan for FY 2021-22. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
1) Receive the final report outcomes for FY 2020-2021 Commission for the Arts Work Plan; and 2) Approve the proposed FY 2021-2022 Commission for the Arts Work Plan.
2021-06-16 Item 08H Commission for Arts Work Plans 2020-2021 and 2021-2022
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
City of Encinitas Community Grant Program Application Requests for FY 2021-22. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
Review and approve the evaluation panel’s recommended funding allocations and make any desired additional allocations to the grant applicants.
2021-06-16 Item 10A City of Encinitas Community Grant Program Application Requests for FY 2021-22
10B.
Introduction of Ordinance No. 2021-04, regulating Cannabis activity in the City of Encinitas consistent with the voter-approved Ordinance No. 2020-18 (Measure H). Contact Person: Associate Planner Jedynak
1) Introduce Ordinance No. 2021-04 to repeal Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 9.21 ((Marijuana and Marijuana-Related Activities and Uses); amend Title 30 - Zoning of the Encinitas Municipal Code; amend the Downtown Encinitas, North 101 Corridor, Encinitas Ranch, and Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plans; and amend the associated sections of the Local Coastal Program regulating cannabis activity; and 2) Consider the Planning Commission recommendation to direct staff to conduct public outreach and prepare maps showing potential locations for each type of use, prepare an odor management ordinance, and develop procedures for filing complaints regarding pesticide drift, odor, or other code enforcement issues relative to cannabis.
2021-06-16 Item 10B Cannabis Ordinance Intro
2021-06-16 Item 10B Cannabis Ordinance Intro - Staff Presentation
2021-06-16 Item 10B Public Comments Received Before 3PM
10C.
Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) and Junior ADU (JADU) proposed incentive program and potential funding sources. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Review the proposed Affordable ADU/JADU Incentive Pilot Program and funding proposed and provide direction to staff.
2021-06-16 Item 10C ADU Incentive Program
2021-06-16 Item 10C ADU Incentive Program - Staff Presentation
2021-06-16 Item 10C Public Comments Received Before 3PM

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
